headlines.description: A quickfire brace from Alexander Isak ensured new Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola got off the mark at the third time of asking with a 2-0 win at Ipswich.
headlines.shortLinkText: Isak gives Iraola a Liverpool win as Barcola debuts

headlines.description: Substitute Jacob Ramsey struck late on as Newcastle came from 2-0 down to snatch a 2-2 draw against Bournemouth and preserve Matthias Jaissle's unbeaten start to his time on Tyneside.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacob Ramsey scores last-gasp equaliser to salvage a point for Newcastle, Bournemouth drop points from winning position again

headlines.description: Enzo Le Fée scored a late penalty to rescue a point for Sunderland in a lively 1-1 draw against Brentford at the Gtech Community Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Enzo Le Fée scores late penalty for Sunderland in lively 1-1 draw with Brentford

events.name: Leeds United at Brighton & Hove Albion

headlines.description: Brighton's club-record signing Luka Vušković headed his first goal in English football to earn a 1-1 Premier League draw at home to Leeds.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teenager Luka Vušković rescues a point for Brighton in 1-1 draw against Leeds

headlines.description: Ben Chilwell celebrated his return to Crystal Palace with a late winner in their 3-2 comeback victory over Fulham at Craven Cottage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fulham win 3-2 at Palace as Chilwell scores at former club

headlines.description: Erling Haaland's first-half header saw Manchester City edge out Coventry 1-0 and make it three wins from three as Enzo Fernandez made an earlier than planned debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland scores only goal as City squeeze past Coventry

headlines.description: Tottenham earned their first point of the Premier League season after a 0-0 draw with Nottingham Forest, but things are still not clicking for Roberto De Zerbi's new-look side.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs take first point of season in goalless draw with Forest

headlines.description: Hull's unbeaten start to life back in the Premier League continued as Sergej Jakirovic's surprise package ended a breathless week by holding rebuilding Aston Villa to a 0-0 draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hull continue unbeaten start to the Premier League season following goalless draw with Aston Villa

headlines.description: Ainsley Maitland-Niles scored a dream stoppage-time equaliser on his Everton debut to earn a 2-2 draw against Manchester United and lift the mood at the end of a difficult week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Everton snatch last-gasp equaliser against Man Utd

headlines.description: Arsenal needed to come from behind to win a breathless game 2-1 against Chelsea at the Emirates Stadium as Kai Havertz scored for the third time in the Premier League against his former club.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal beat Chelsea, maintain perfect start

headlines.description: Bournemouth boss Marco Rose was denied a first Premier League win after a calamitous goalkeeping mistake allowed Brentford to claim a 2-2 draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schade brace extends Bournemouth's winless run

headlines.description: Igor Jesus piled the misery on Aston Villa as his late goal snatched a 2-1 victory for Nottingham Forest at Villa Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Forest winner piles misery on Aston Villa

headlines.description: Chelsea's chaotic start to life under Xabi Alonso continued with an entertaining 2-2 draw against Hull at Stamford Bridge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chelsea draw with PL surprise package Hull City

headlines.description: Zian Flemming's first goal for Ipswich snatched a dramatic 3-2 victory at 10-man Crystal Palace for their second Premier League win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ipswich beat 10-man Palace with 90th-min winner

headlines.description: Fulham frustrated Liverpool to claim their first point of the season with a goalless draw at Anfield on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liverpool held by out-of-form Fulham at Anfield

headlines.description: Tottenham Hotspur fired another blank after being frustrated by Everton in a 0-0 draw to extend their winless start to the new Premier League season to four matches.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winless Spurs still searching for 1st goal after Everton draw

headlines.description: Bruno Guimarães and Bukayo Saka helped maintain Arsenal's perfect start in the Premier League with a 2-0 win over Sunderland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guimarães stunner helps Arsenal keep perfect start

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Coventry City

headlines.description: Brighton dealt 10-man Coventry a crushing 5-0 defeat to condemn them to a fourth straight Premier League loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dunk screamer helps Brighton pile more PL misery on Lampard's Coventry

headlines.description: Erling Haaland secured Manchester City a memorable derby-day triumph as Manchester United failed to capitalise on Phil Foden's sending-off on a day of contentious decisions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland goal decides VAR-heavy Manchester derby for 10-man City

headlines.description: Leeds sent sorry Newcastle spinning to a 4-1 defeat at Elland Road to extend their unbeaten Premier League start and climb to third in the table.
headlines.shortLinkText: Unbeaten Leeds cruise past Newcastle 4-1

headlines.description: Chelsea's winless run in the Premier League stretched to three matches as Brentford ran out deserved 3-0 winners at the Gtech Community Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: High-flying Brentford hammer struggling Chelsea

headlines.description: Aston Villa piled the pressure on big-spending Tottenham and Roberto De Zerbi with a 3-2 away victory to claim a first win in the Premier League this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drab Tottenham fall to Aston Villa defeat

headlines.description: Arsenal's 100% start to their Premier League title defence ended in emphatic fashion as Brighton secured a stunning 3-0 win against Mikel Arteta's dumbstruck side.
headlines.shortLinkText: Champions Arsenal battered by brilliant Brighton

headlines.description: Abdul Fatawu's dismissal after being shown a second yellow card for diving capped a frustrating afternoon for Ipswich in their 1-0 defeat at Everton.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barry strikes for Everton to sink 10-man Ipswich

headlines.description: Hull's unbeaten start to life in the Premier League came to an end with a 2-1 defeat to Newcastle at St James' Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newcastle strike early, end Hull's unbeaten record

headlines.description: Jay DaSilva fired Coventry to their first Premier League win in 25 years as they beat Nottingham Forest 1-0 in another game mired by VAR controversy.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coventry claim first PL win of season at Forest

headlines.description: Alexander Isak's second-half strike secured Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola all three points on his return to the Vitality Stadium in a 1-0 victory over his old club Bournemouth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Iraola's Liverpool triumph on Bournemouth return

headlines.description: Leeds and Crystal Palace battle to gritty goalless draw
headlines.shortLinkText: Leeds and Palace battle to gritty goalless draw

headlines.description: Brian Brobbey scored a hat trick in a losing cause as Manchester City maintained their 100% Premier League start with a frantic 5-3 win over Sunderland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man City down Sunderland in eight-goal thriller

headlines.description: A comical own goal by Lisandro Martinez saw Manchester United fail to win for a third Premier League game in a row as they drew 1-1 with Fulham at Craven Cottage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man United rescue draw at Fulham after own goal
